title: Fix worktree sync: never stage .beads symlink; rerere; dynamic branch loop
description: Worker branches record a typechange (.beads dir -> symlink) whenever .beads is staged, poisoning every merge to main. Fix: worker prompt step 6 stages only changed files; sync script excludes :!.beads pathspecs everywhere, enables rerere (repo config), iterates beads-worker-* branches dynamically instead of hardcoded 1..5, reports conflicted branches and exits 1. Exclusion verified against a real symlinked worktree.
close_reason: Exclusion pathspec verified against a real symlinked worktree; sync + worker prompt updated; rerere enabled.
